device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

trident_h_per_frame.source: gate6 cache build, 4 shards x 1 GPU; includes NPZ writes so it is an upper bound

notes.lingbot: timed over a 5-frame streaming replay and divided by 5; keyframe_interval=1
notes.moge: runs on the first 5 frames of a sequence only, then ScaleState freezes; amortised cost per frame over an N-frame sequence is 5/N of this
notes.trident: Trident-H runs in its own conda environment (tools/gate6/cache_semantics.py) and is not importable here; see the cache build log for its rate
notes.occany: OccAny emits one prediction per sample and consumes its five frames inside that sample, so seconds/sample is its per-output cost. Measured from its own run on this machine (MUSt3R + generative novel-view rendering, --gen --batch_gen_view 12).

totals_ms.moge2_amortised_note: MoGe runs on the first 5 frames only; over an N-frame sequence add 5/N x 42.5 ms
